title: Adorable Brazilian Bread Cookies
description: Buttery, springy cookies with light brown soft sugar, a hint of coconut and a char-grill-yang finish, perfect for kids and made on a raclette grill.
instructions: Preheat a raclette grill to medium‑high heat.
In a bowl, beat the softened butter and brown sugar until creamy.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and sea salt in a separate bowl.
Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the butter mixture, mixing until just combined.
Stir in the vanilla extract and coconut milk until a smooth dough forms.
If using coconut flakes, fold them into the dough now.
Shape the dough into small rounds about 2 cm in diameter.
Place the rounds on the preheated grill and cook for 3–4 minutes on each side until a light char appears.
Remove the cookies and cool them on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Serve warm or store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
